note:
Move every management paper onto MA by one translation (+ (A - B), A / B = corpus means), build a bisecting
k-means tree per corpus, decode each node's representative (management: before and after the move), and map
MA + moved management + the node representatives with t-SNE in 2D and 3D. Not pre-registered (qualitative + map).

    python3 m2ma.py tree                            # -> m2ma_space.npz, m2ma_membership.csv.gz, m2ma_nodes.json
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=g python3 m2ma.py decode   # -> m2ma_decode.json
    python3 m2ma.py map                             # -> m2ma_map.csv.gz (papers + nodes, 2D and 3D)
    python3 m2ma.py write                           # -> m2ma_tree.json (nodes + decodes + coordinates)

Space for the tree and the map: adapted pooled genes, management moved by (A - B), unit rows -> joint PCA-50 -> unit.
Tree: per corpus, KMeans(2, random_state 0, n_init 4) splits each node, depth 4 (up to 16 leaves); nodes under
MIN_SPLIT papers are not split. Node id: 'ma' / 'm' for the roots, then '.0' / '.1' per split.
Node representative on the map: unit(mean of its members' 50-d rows), added to the t-SNE input as extra points.
Decoding: raw FULL-RANK centroid of the members [36, 8, 512] from the gene shards (moved management: + (A - B) with
A / B the full-rank corpus means), then unit per slot (the cluster-summary recipe; HANDOFF4 region names).
